main_text.head: Canon quo horarum partes sexagesimæ convertuntur in Helakim; vel contra.
main_text.l: Helakim | Sexagesimæ partes prim. sec. tert.
main_text.p: Horam partiuntur Iudęi Chaldæi & Arabes in partes 1080. quæ dicuntur Helakim, in numero singulari Helak.
Si proponantur Helakim 200. mutanda in scrup. sexagesima sic agendum. 198. Helakim faciunt 11 & duo Helak. sunt sec. 6. tert. 40. Quare 200. Helak. valent 11. 6. 40.
Rursus, sūto scrupula 47. 30. convertenda in Helakim. illa sunt 846. & sec. 30. sunt Helak. 9. hoc est simul 855. Helakim.
Numerus 1080. est in multas partes dividu[?],& ideo ad horam dividēdam idoneus.

page.notes: The centre table's header reads "Sexagesimæ partes" with sub-columns prim., sec., tert. The text "dividu⁹" is uncertain. Faint show-through from the facing page is not transcribed. The table rows are given as printed; the first and last columns of the left table are taken as printed.
